Add a lesson to the register
Fail unless CHANGELOG.md keeps an Unreleased section and one for the current version.
Fail when a tracked source or config file has no SPDX-License-Identifier in its first five lines.
Fail when a package, capability, role, plugin, compose stack or tool has no tests.
Fail unless each of the fourteen capabilities has a passing conformance suite.
Fail when an event type or shared lake table lacks a schema with publisher and consumer contract-test fixtures.
Fail when a security-critical unit drops below its line-coverage floor from its own tests.
Report every remaining reference to a service retired by a swap (ADR-0005 step 8).
Fail when copy-pasted Python appears that the committed duplication baseline does not hold; the baseline only shrinks.
Serve the deterministic fake OpenAI-compatible inference API.
Fail when a bugfix commit (a fix subject or a Fixes trailer) ships no regression test; with --prove, also when that test passes on the parent commit.
Fail when test code reads the wall clock or unseeded randomness directly, or library code reads the clock other than as an injectable default.
Refuse to publish the lab beyond loopback unless asked and every credential is changed.
Serve an in-memory fake case system for the cases capability.
Initialise the lab object store and Iceberg catalog once (idempotent).
Rehearse the lake-query swap on the lab-in-a-box (fake lake to Trino) and roll it back.
Bring the lab-in-a-box up, check every service, run conformance where present, tear down.
One real round trip against every lab-in-a-box service, as a JSON report.
Fail when the tree, a commit range or stdin carries a private identifier or a secret shape.
Fail when code or config writes an endpoint literal instead of a registry lookup.
Allocate XX-NEW register ids, and fail when an id vanished or occurs twice.
Fail when a role or playbook breaks the role interface (docs/role-interface.md).
Fail when a schema is invalid, lacks an example or a negative, or breaks its frozen baseline.
Fail when a private notify, state or lake-query helper is re-implemented outside the shared libraries (reviewed allowlist).
Fail when Python code or a YAML/JSON config turns TLS certificate verification off.
Fail when a runtime config, role, compose file, example or golden output points at the admin workstation.
